notes.title: Early Access Build v0.3e
notes.content:
In v0.3e, we've added the following major features:

Kill The King (New Game Mode) - In Kill The King, you start off with a single king and many peasants.   Peasants must work together to dethrone the king, with the killer taking their place. Peasants can only kill the king to gain points and take their place, but cannot kill each other. However, as the king, you can kill all the peasants to gain points and keep your title as king. The player with the most points wins. This game mode is essentially a 1vAll Team Deathmatch mode where killing the target causes you to become the target, but gives you the opportunity to gain more points.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092491/b3d6db51cfdc0b7b91a61484dc33d253f092f2cf.png
 macOS Support - Sausage Fest is now available on macOS! We are now officially supporting both Windows and macOS.


These are some major updates to Sausage Fest for v0.3e for the month of September. Please visit our Discord if you wish to give your feedback on the game. The next Major Update is planned to be in October. These updates will bring more content to the Early Access Builds. All updates will be announced on both Steam and our Discord Server.

notes.title: Early Access Build v0.2e
notes.content:
In v0.2e, we've made some minor changes to improve the experience of the game. We have added the following things:

A Camera Lock System - The new update features a camera lock system that allows you to toggle between locking your character to the center of the screen or being able to move the camera around. You can toggle this option in-game by pressing the Y Key (100% Original). We have enabled this by default to make navigation easier for newer players.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092491/3e79bc217c6294dbfd00a6f4281de29c21f42891.png
Info on Drops - You can press the view drops button in the Drops menu when in a room to view all the drops in the game. Players will also see what each drop does when picked up in-game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38092491/a4c0ee8ec53fefebea68ef40f9401c289b4b4e06.png


These are minor updates to Sausage Fest for v0.2e that were requested by some of our players. Please visit our Discord if you also wish to give your feedback on the game. Major updates are planned to be once a month, these updates will bring more content to the Early Access Builds. All updates will be announced on both Steam and our Discord Server.
